Here’s a quick rundown of the tools you now have at your disposal:

**File‑system helpers**

| Function | Purpose |
|----------|---------|
| `cd` | Change the current working directory (one level up or down). |
| `ls` | List the contents of the current directory (`-a` shows hidden items). |
| `pwd` | Show the full path of the current working directory. |
| `mkdir` | Create a new directory in the current location. |
| `rmdir` | Remove an empty directory in the current location. |
| `rm` | Delete a file in the current location. |
| `touch` | Create an empty file (or update its timestamp) in the current location. |
| `cp` | Copy a file or directory to a new name or into a target directory. |
| `mv` | Move or rename a file or directory. |
| `cat` | Display the entire contents of a file. |
| `tail` | Show the last *n* lines of a file (default 10). |
| `grep` | Search for a text pattern inside a file. |
| `sort` | Sort the lines of a file alphabetically. |
| `find` | Recursively locate files or directories matching a name pattern. |
| `du` | Estimate the disk usage of a directory (optionally human‑readable). |
| `wc` | Count lines, words, or characters in a file (`-l`, `-w`, `-c`). |

**Math helpers**

| Function | Purpose |
|----------|---------|
| `absolute_value` | Compute the absolute value of a number. |
| `add` | Add two numbers. |
| `subtract` | Subtract one number from another. |
| `multiply` | Multiply two numbers. |
| `divide` | Divide one number by another. |
| `power` | Raise a base to an exponent. |
| `square_root` | Compute the square root of a number with adjustable precision. |
| `logarithm` | Compute a logarithm with adjustable precision. |
| `round_number` | Round a number to a specified number of decimal places. |
| `percentage` | Compute a percentage of a part relative to a whole. |
| `sum_values` | Sum a list of numbers. |
| `mean` | Compute the arithmetic mean of a list of numbers. |
| `min_value` | Find the minimum value in a list. |
| `max_value` | Find the maximum value in a list. |
| `standard_deviation` | Compute the standard deviation of a list of numbers. |
| `imperial_si_conversion` | Convert a value between imperial and SI units. |
| `si_unit_conversion` | Convert a value from one SI unit to another. |

Feel free to pick any of these tools to work on your files or perform calculations!

ChatCompletionMessage(content='Here’s a quick rundown of the tools you now have at your disposal:

**File‑system helpers**

| Function | Purpose |
|----------|---------|
| `cd` | Change the current working directory (one level up or down). |
| `ls` | List the contents of the current directory (`-a` shows hidden items). |
| `pwd` | Show the full path of the current working directory. |
| `mkdir` | Create a new directory in the current location. |
| `rmdir` | Remove an empty directory in the current location. |
| `rm` | Delete a file in the current location. |
| `touch` | Create an empty file (or update its timestamp) in the current location. |
| `cp` | Copy a file or directory to a new name or into a target directory. |
| `mv` | Move or rename a file or directory. |
| `cat` | Display the entire contents of a file. |
| `tail` | Show the last *n* lines of a file (default 10). |
| `grep` | Search for a text pattern inside a file. |
| `sort` | Sort the lines of a file alphabetically. |
| `find` | Recursively locate files or directories matching a name pattern. |
| `du` | Estimate the disk usage of a directory (optionally human‑readable). |
| `wc` | Count lines, words, or characters in a file (`-l`, `-w`, `-c`). |

**Math helpers**

| Function | Purpose |
|----------|---------|
| `absolute_value` | Compute the absolute value of a number. |
| `add` | Add two numbers. |
| `subtract` | Subtract one number from another. |
| `multiply` | Multiply two numbers. |
| `divide` | Divide one number by another. |
| `power` | Raise a base to an exponent. |
| `square_root` | Compute the square root of a number with adjustable precision. |
| `logarithm` | Compute a logarithm with adjustable precision. |
| `round_number` | Round a number to a specified number of decimal places. |
| `percentage` | Compute a percentage of a part relative to a whole. |
| `sum_values` | Sum a list of numbers. |
| `mean` | Compute the arithmetic mean of a list of numbers. |
| `min_value` | Find the minimum value in a list. |
| `max_value` | Find the maximum value in a list. |
| `standard_deviation` | Compute the standard deviation of a list of numbers. |
